newsitem.title: USA: Intelect in $10 mln financing plan.
newsitem.headline: Intelect in $10 mln financing plan.

text.p: Intelect Communications Systems Ltd said Friday it has begun a new financing agreement with a trust unit of The Coastal Corporation Pension Plan, which will provide it with up to $10 million in debt and equity funding.

Under the plan the company said it received a one-year $5 million loan at two percentage points over prime and expects to receive an additional $5 million during the next 30 days in exchange for preferred convertible stock. The loan, said the company, may also be exchanged for preverred convertible at a lated date.
INTELECT is a communications technology company whose products include digital fiber optic multiplexers, programmable telecommunications switches and multimedia network conferencing systems.
